items.title: Tom Scott interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, April 1, 2022 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Anyway it was like Tom and John Bayler who were singers and John was an arranger also

ctx.x: That was a record that featured much of the L.A. studio guys and I think did we have a singer? I can’t remember. Anyway it was like Tom and John Bayler who were singers and John was an arranger also, and gosh Mike Melvoin, Jim Horn on saxophone, again, Ollie Mitchell, Chuck Findley on trumpets, Slyde Hyde. It may have been, I can’t remember who the other trombone player was. Maybe George Bohannon. And who played drums, John Guerin played drums, Max Bennett on bass, I think maybe Larry Carlton on guitar. It was…

Before we get to — we have to talk about your own solo recordings. What has happened to the business? I think of all the jazz graduates coming out of the schools every year and many of them must head to L.A. Is there any — what’s the business like for them to head to these days?
